SPEC DEFECT FOUND AND CORRECTED
rules/01 section 11 supplies this off-8pt regex:
    (padding|margin|gap):[^;]*\b(1[13579]|2[1235679]|3[01345679]|[5-9][0-9])px
It only matches ODD teens. padding:18px, 20px, 28px and 36px all pass it silently.
Replaced with membership testing against the actual scale
(0 4 8 12 16 24 32 40 48 64 80 96 128). Verified: 18px now caught.

LINT SCOPE, deliberate: src/ only. The 1,593 legacy pages carry roughly 1,500 inline
style attributes and are not in scope until their template cluster migrates. Linting
them now would report thousands of violations against untouched code and make the
check useless. Scope widens per cluster.
